The '''Warriors of Shadow''' were an all-[[Gender/Legends|female]] cult that was an offshoot of the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] civilization, also known as the Warriors of the Shadow. After the Taung [[Species/Legends|species]] were driven off their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Notron]] (now known as Coruscant) by the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]], a number of female Taung formed a sisterhood and fled to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to seek atonement through meditation and insight.<ref name="Unknown" /> At one point during their history, the Warriors [[Battle above a nameless moon|battled]] a rival cult, the [[Knell of Muspilli]], above a [[Unidentified moon (Unknown Regions)|moon]] in the Unknown Regions.<ref name="Battle of Terror">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Battle of Terror}}</ref> However, the Warriors of Shadow merged with the Knell and a third cult, the [[Kanzer Exiles]], over the course of thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] on the twelve [[Planet/Legends|planets]] of the [[Nihil Retreat]].<ref name="Unknown" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Warriors of Shadow were first mentioned in the [[2010]] reference guide ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'',<ref name="Unknown" /> and identified as "The Warriors of the Shadow" by [[Daniel Wallace]]'s endotes.<ref name="endnotes1">{{Blog|danwallace|168|Endnotes for Star Wars: The Unknown Regions}}</ref><ref name="endnotes2">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2010/04/endnotes-for-star-wars-unknown-regions.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Unknown Regions}}</ref> They were later named as the "Warriors of Shadow" in the Archaeology crewskill mission "Battle of Terror" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Battle of Terror" />
